observation_loinc.description: HiRID observation variable (name and id) -> LOINC (exact LOINC name matches)

origin.added: variable_name, variable_name_source: description of the non-pharma varref.tsv rows, ratschlab/HIRID-ICU-Benchmark bee770094bf8389920bc09823895b87e09a563dd (MIT)

observation_loinc.sources: HiRID raw-variable spreadsheet linked at https://hirid.intensivecare.ai/data-details (cited only, no license stated; used to choose matches, no text copied); ratschlab/HIRID-ICU-Benchmark preprocessing/resources/varref.tsv @ bee7700 (MIT), the source of every variableid and variable_name; codes resolved in LOINC 2.80; per-row provenance in match/source and variable_name_source
observation_loinc.license: Mapping columns: MIT (sumeds-ontologies); variable names from HIRID-ICU-Benchmark varref.tsv (MIT). loinc_long_common_name: LONG_COMMON_NAME from the LOINC pack, LOINC license (notice in LOINC_short_license.txt)
observation_loinc.notes: HiRID MEDS codes are OBSERVATION//{variable name, else variableid}//{unit}. Key a rule on variable_name for named codes and a second rule ('^OBSERVATION//(?P<key>[0-9]+)//', key_column variableid) for the id fallback. Names contain '/' but never '//'.
